description: Generate image or video media through the Bento model gateway using an exact upstream model ID or role. Roles: image, image:google, video, video:grok, video:pro, video:seedance, video:google, video:kling, video:kling:image. Omit model to use the role matching kind. Optional video controls: duration in seconds and resolution as WIDTHxHEIGHT.
name: media_generate
